faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XE D240 use?
faqLeft.a: The XE D240 uses the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XE D240 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ200D XE D240 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn timing chains, injectors, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you supply used XE D240 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XE D240 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XE D240 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XE D240 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
